# Book It Daily

> Book It Daily is booking and membership software for yoga & pilates studios, gyms, and personal trainers. It runs as an installable web app (PWA) and covers class & 1-on-1 bookings, class packs and memberships, client records, 1-to-1 messaging, and finance/payouts — in one place.

## What it is
- Category: booking and membership software (SaaS) for fitness & wellness businesses — yoga studios, pilates studios, gyms, boutique fitness studios, and personal trainers / coaches.
- Roles: Owner (runs the business and pays the subscription), Admin/Instructor (the trainer who delivers classes and sessions), Client (the member who books).
- Delivery: progressive web app (PWA) installable on iOS and Android home screens; also works on desktop.

## Key facts
- Pricing is a flat monthly subscription in USD — there are no transaction fees on the studio's revenue. Owners keep 100% of what their clients pay them.
- Plans: Free ($0/mo), Solo ($9/mo or $90/yr), Studio ($24/mo or $240/yr). Paid plans include a 14-day free trial.
- The subscription is billed through Paddle (Merchant of Record), which handles VAT/sales tax globally.
- Book It Daily does NOT process the payments a studio's own clients make — studios plug in their own gateway (Stripe, Paddle, Square, cash, bank transfer).
- Differentiators: native class packs and memberships, group classes + 1-on-1 sessions, per-instructor commission splits, and a built-in finance dashboard — at a flat low price with no revenue cut.
- Compared to alternatives: Acuity and Calendly are schedulers only (no class packs or memberships); Mindbody and Glofox do more but are expensive and complex for small studios. Book It Daily is the simple, affordable option.
- Data: encrypted at rest, daily backups, GDPR-compliant, full CSV export at any time.
